covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Friday, August 14, 2026 market close and before the Monday, August 17, 2026 market open

market_context_summary: At the research cutoff, SPY was down about 0.25% and Bitcoin was near $63,085. July retail sales fell 0.6% and preliminary August consumer sentiment dropped to 51.0, adding a softer macro tone to the quiet late-summer Friday session and weekend gap.

universe_notes.calendar_entries_screened: All reasonably relevant U.S.-listed entries in the immediate window were screened.
universe_notes.exclusion_summary: Estimated or time-unspecified dates, already-reported names, microcaps, and thinly traded issuers were excluded before the three passes. FSI had explicit timing but was excluded because its roughly $64 million market capitalization and very low trading volume failed the liquidity standard.

top_setups.note: There were not three evidence-qualified setups on either side in this unusually sparse window.

pass_outputs.key_metric: Revenue versus the $82.5-$82.8 million consensus bar
Realized Bitcoin economics and network-difficulty pressure

consensus_method.disparity_definition: 0-100 dispersion summary using the spread of direction and reversal-risk outputs across Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C; lower means tighter agreement.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-08-14 after market close; conference call 2026-08-17 at 8:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Existing expectation-bar and forward-look checks applied; no new method change
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A high consensus revenue bar and three straight EPS misses leave HIVE vulnerable if lower Bitcoin economics or network difficulty pressure gross operating margin, but heavy short crowding creates sharp relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public estimates cluster near a $0.20 loss per share and $82.5-$82.8 million revenue, up from fiscal Q4 revenue of $71.8 million; the company reported 25.1 EH/s installed at March 31.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue clears the low-$80 millions, mining margin holds better than feared, and BUZZ HPC guidance validates the AI-infrastructure narrative.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Revenue or mining gross margin misses as Bitcoin price and network difficulty offset hashrate scale; financing and dilution concerns weigh on the forward view.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public options data indicated roughly a 35% expected move for the September expiration. Short interest was 60.44 million shares, or 22.5% of float, as of July 31, making the setup highly squeeze-prone.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus is based on only about three estimates; public sources show a roughly $0.20 loss forecast and three consecutive EPS misses, limiting reliability and confidence.

research_allocation_view.reason: HIVE's absolute score exceeds 30, but consensus reversal risk of 65 is above the 40 cutoff.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All three independent passes leaned down. The average direction score was -32.7 and average reversal risk was 65.3; low disparity (8) shows agreement on the base direction, while risk remained high in every pass.
detailed_company_sections.recommendation: Lean Down; do not prioritize in the research allocation basket
detailed_company_sections.thesis: The decisive metric is mining gross operating margin, not headline EPS.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_up: Better mining economics, resilient gross margin, or credible BUZZ HPC growth commentary could clear a de-risked bar.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_down: A revenue miss, margin compression, higher network difficulty, financing dilution, or cautious HPC timing could outweigh hashrate growth.
detailed_company_sections.reversal_risk_assessment: High: short interest was 22.5% of float as of July 31, the stock was below July reference prices, and high implied volatility could turn a merely less-bad print into a squeeze.
detailed_company_sections.social_sentiment_read: The visible HIVE community is strongly bullish and AI-infrastructure focused, but it is small, promotional, and not treated as primary evidence.
detailed_company_sections.options_positioning_read: Approximately 35% public expected-move indication for September; event-specific weekly pricing was not reliably available.
detailed_company_sections.analyst_revision_read: Sparse coverage and only about three estimates reduce the precision of the published consensus.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Revenue lands below or near consensus with pressured mining margin; shares lean lower but remain within the very wide implied range.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Low-$80 million-plus revenue, stronger realized Bitcoin economics, and concrete HPC backlog or guidance trigger a short squeeze.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Revenue and margin miss together, while dilution or capex commentary reinforces balance-sheet concerns.
detailed_company_sections.final_directional_judgment: Lean Down, not Strong Down, because the negative operating setup is offset by a de-risked price and severe squeeze risk.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_rationale: Excluded because reversal risk of 65 is well above the model's 40 ceiling despite an absolute score above 30.
detailed_company_sections.disparity_effect: Low disparity supports consistency of the bearish read, but it cannot override high opposite-direction squeeze risk.
detailed_company_sections.method_update_note: No new method change. Existing expectation-bar, key-metric-first, and forward-look checks were applied.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
